blue.style: Blue pairs well with neutral tones for a clean and balanced look.

black.style: Black is versatile and works with both neutral and bold colors.

white.style: White is flexible and pairs well with most colors.

brown.style: Brown works well with earthy and soft tones.

beige.style: Beige is a calm neutral that works well with earthy colours and blue accents.

grey.style: Grey provides a quiet base for both neutral and accent colours.

green.style: Green pairs naturally with neutrals and other earthy tones.

red.style: Red is strongest when balanced by restrained neutral colours.
